source: It is not the case that this principle is universal and exceptionless. This principle is universal. Therefore this principle is not exceptionless.

reconstruction.title: Argument about the universality and exceptionlessness of a principle

claims.text: It is not the case that this principle is universal and exceptionless.

evidence.quote: It is not the case that this principle is universal and exceptionless.

translations.reason: Translates 'It is not the case that this principle is universal and exceptionless' as the negation of the conjunction of P and Q
Directly asserts 'This principle is universal' as proposition P
Translates 'This principle is not exceptionless' as the negation of Q

interpretation_notes: The argument uses classical propositional logic with standard negation and conjunction operators
The conclusion follows from premises via disjunctive syllogism (if ¬(P∧Q) and P, then ¬Q)
